facts.heading: Divorce from husband
facts.content: Jana and Radka decided to divorce after 15 years of marriage. Jana still cannot understand the decision.
facts.evidence: After 15 years of marriage, we decided to divorce with my husband Radka. And I still can't understand it.

facts.heading: Divorce occurred last year
facts.content: Jana and Radka were still in Croatia last year. Radek told Jana it was not possible anymore.
facts.evidence: We were still in Croatia last year. And in September he told me that it's not possible anymore.

facts.heading: Emotional state during divorce
facts.content: Jana felt empty, anger, and emptiness thirteen times a day.
facts.evidence: Empty. Then anger. Then again emptiness. Thirteen times a day.

facts.heading: Regret about past actions
facts.content: Jana thinks she should have seen things and feels blind. She keeps looking back where she made a mistake.
facts.evidence: That I should have seen it, that I'm blind. I keep looking back in my head where I made a mistake.

facts.heading: Reasons for suffering
facts.content: Jana is suffering mainly because of the children.
facts.evidence: Yes, mainly because of the children.

facts.heading: Children's ages
facts.content: Jana has two children, Anička is 12 and Matěj is 8 years old.
facts.evidence: I have two children. Anička is 12 and Matěj is 8 years old.

facts.heading: Anička's concern about father
facts.content: Last week Anička asked Jana if they were arguing with Dad. Jana said no.
facts.evidence: Last week she asked me if we were arguing with dad. I said no.

facts.heading: Lying to Anička
facts.content: Jana felt terrible because she lied to Anička and Anička knew it.
facts.evidence: I felt terrible. Because I lied to her. And she knew it.

facts.heading: Fear of telling the truth
facts.content: Jana is afraid of the children's tears when telling the truth.
facts.evidence: I'm afraid of their tears.

facts.heading: Plan for telling children
facts.content: Radek wants them to tell the news together, but they postpone it.
facts.evidence: Radek wants us to tell them together. but we still postpone it.

facts.heading: Matěj's understanding level
facts.content: Matěj is still a kid and does not understand much.
facts.evidence: Matěj is still a kid, he doesn't understand anything.

facts.heading: Jana's daily work
facts.content: Jana works as a Czech teacher at a primary school in Brno.
facts.evidence: I work as a Czech teacher at a primary school in Brno.

facts.heading: Jana's teaching level
facts.content: Jana teaches 9th and 8th graders.
facts.evidence: I teach 9th and 8th graders.

facts.heading: Walking with chair in neck
facts.content: Jana walks with a chair in her neck until 3 o'clock.
facts.evidence: I walk with a chair in my neck until 3 o'clock.

facts.heading: Feels life is falling apart
facts.content: Jana feels like everyone sees her life is falling apart.
facts.evidence: I feel like everyone sees that my life is falling apart.

facts.heading: Teacher knows about situation
facts.content: Only the teacher knows about Jana's situation.
facts.evidence: Only the teacher.

facts.heading: Told teacher about crying
facts.content: Jana told the teacher she cried at a dance.
facts.evidence: I told her that because I once cried at the dance.

facts.heading: Feeling happy helped
facts.content: Being very happy helped Jana.
facts.evidence: I was very happy.

facts.heading: Work situation made it worse
facts.content: Jana sat at home and it was worse because she was alone at work.
facts.evidence: Because I was alone at work. I had to do something.

facts.heading: Sleep problems every night
facts.content: Jana sleeps badly every night and wakes up at 3 a.m. to think about what's next.
facts.evidence: Every night I wake up at 3 a.m. and think about what's next.

facts.heading: Wakes up at specific times
facts.content: Jana sleeps around 5 am and gets up at 7.30 am.
facts.evidence: I sleep around 5 am and get up at 7.30 am.

facts.heading: Low weight loss reported
facts.content: Jana does not eat much and has lost 4 kilos.
facts.evidence: I don't eat much. I've lost 4 kilos.

facts.heading: Friend comments on appearance
facts.content: A friend tells Jana that she looks terrible.
facts.evidence: My friend tells me that I look terrible.

facts.heading: Has two people to talk to
facts.content: Jana has a sister in Olomouc and a friend of Eva from work.
facts.evidence: I have a sister in Olomouc, she calls me almost every evening and a friend of Eva from work.

facts.heading: Friend wants Jana to struggle
facts.content: Eva wants Jana to have a hard time and does not want her to think about anything.
facts.evidence: Eva just wants me to have a hard time. She doesn't want me to think about anything.

facts.heading: Fear about being a bad example
facts.content: Jana is afraid that she lied and that a woman who can't keep a marriage is not a good example for children.
facts.evidence: That I lied. That a woman who can't keep a marriage is not a good example for children.

facts.heading: Fear comes from mother
facts.content: The fear about being a bad example probably comes from her mom.
facts.evidence: Probably from my mom. She always said that marriage is a thing and that it is what it is.

facts.heading: Mother's reaction to introduction
facts.content: Jana's mother was silent and then said she hoped Jana had been good to her.
facts.evidence: She was silent. Then she said that she hopes I have been good to her.

facts.heading: Jana feels sad
facts.content: Jana feels sad and needs forgiveness.
facts.evidence: Sad. I need you to forgive me.

facts.heading: Jana cries and apologizes
facts.content: When Jana says it out loud, she cries and apologizes.
facts.evidence: I cry and I apologize.

facts.heading: Has not told anyone yet
facts.content: Jana has not told anyone about what she said yet.
facts.evidence: I haven't told anyone yet.

facts.heading: Wants sleep help tried
facts.content: Jana has tried herb tea for sleeping.
facts.evidence: Herb tea and that's all.

facts.heading: Fear of not waking up
facts.content: Jana is afraid she won't be able to wake up for her children in time. She does not want to be dependent.
facts.evidence: I'm afraid I won't be able to wake up for my children in time and I don't want to be dependent.

facts.heading: Desire to write down thoughts
facts.content: Jana could write down what wakes her up. She hopes this will get the thoughts out of her head.
facts.evidence: I could. At least I'll get it out of my head.

facts.heading: Fear of panicking
facts.content: Jana is afraid she will panic and cry. She is afraid she won't be able to stay calm.
facts.evidence: That I'll panic and cry. That I won't be able to stay calm.

facts.heading: Concern about children's perception
facts.content: Jana is concerned about whether she will be scared of children. She wonders if it would be scary for them.
facts.evidence: That I'd be scared of children? That it would be scary for them?

facts.heading: Allowing sadness for Anička
facts.content: Jana thought that children could see that sadness is allowed. She considered that it might help Anička because she is sensitive.
facts.evidence: Or they could see that the sadness is allowed. And Anička is sensitive. Maybe it would help her.

facts.heading: Feeling of not being alone
facts.content: Jana wants to feel that she is not alone. She wants to feel she does not have to manage things right away.
facts.evidence: That I'm not alone and I don't have to manage it right away.
